easyPrerequisites: Mardu Siegebreaker must be exiled by Changeling Hero, and Glorious Protector must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Glorious Protector for its mana cost.
When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Changeling Hero until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
When Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, Mardu Siegebreaker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it exiles Glorious Protector until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Mardu Siegebreaker's ETB.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Changeling Hero is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Hero enters, it exiles Mardu Siegebreaker until Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Hero's ETB.
When Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, Glorious Protector is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
